about_the_game:
Hacker's Life is a game where you become a hacker and make your own malware. You can infect devices all over the world and join forces with other hackers to launch bigger attacks. See your malware spread and your fame grow, but be careful not to get caught by the authorities.



Name your malware whatever you want, pick its type, and select the device you want to infect. Whether it's a PC, a console, or a smart device you want to infect, you have many options to choose from. Customize how your malware affects different parts of the device and add special abilities to make it more unique and unpredictable. Unleash your creativity and see what kind of havoc you can cause with your malware.


Collect victim's IP addresses and passwords and use them for your own benefit. You can either sell them on the Dark Store a shady online marketplace, or hack into their files and steal their secrets. How far will you go in this cybercrime adventure?


If you want to be a great hacker, you need to keep learning new skills. Skill Up website, where you can find all kinds of courses to improve your hacking abilities. You can learn how to make different kinds of malware, how to target different devices, and how to add new functions to your malware. The more you learn, the more powerful your malware will be. You will be able to create the most destructive malware ever and become the best hacker in the world!


Dark store, is the underground online market where hackers trade their skills and secrets for money. Whether you want to unleash a quick global malware or just make a quick buck, you can find what you need here. Buy ready-made malware from other hackers or sell your own creations to the highest bidder. Or get access to user data that will help you craft malware with special abilities. But be careful, the dark store is not a safe place, and you never know who you can trust.


If you want to be a famous hacker with global known attacks, you can't do it alone. You need to team up with other hackers who share your goals and skills. Together, you can pull off bigger and better hacks that target specific organizations. You can hack the power grid, erase data from big companies' cloud storage, or disrupt the communication networks. It's fun to cause chaos with your hacker buddies. But watch out, this is not a game, you have to obey the group rules and do your part or face serious consequences.



  • Customize malware type, and its abilities the way you like.
  • Gain insights into how your malware is performing.
  • Learn new malware types.
  • Learn new target devices.
  • Learn new abilities.
  • Join forces with other hackers.
  • Plan and execute global attacks.

See your malware take control of the world and become famous for your hacking skills, but be careful not to get busted.
